video.title: What AI Actually Does for Me: Codex, Claude, Blender & Everyday Tasks
video.description:
What do AI agents actually help me do? I walk through my current workflow for turning my daughter Lilly's Wild Rebellion drawings into animation and a Roblox prototype, choosing tools for different tasks, and handling everyday jobs.

Topics include Codex and Astra, Claude Code, Blender, Roblox, Google Antigravity, MiniMax audio, Meta Muse, Hermes, subscription value, and an example of using AI to help with product returns. I finish with my view on creativity, practical value, and AI risk.

Recorded September 23, 2026. This is my personal experience and opinion; model names, plans, availability and prices reflect the discussion at recording time and may change. The investing discussion is personal commentary, not financial advice.
